claims.claim: On the init thread, between start() and engine-ready, NO consumer reads m_legacy_root_directory, m_game_executable_directory, or m_working_directory for behavior when mod_source is active. setup_paths' mod_source branch returns early (PROG:777-784) before the game-specific-config directory scan (:791-808) and legacy fallbacks (:814-817, :856-858); setup_mod_directory_path uses the logical key 'ue4ss/Mods' (PROG:835-839); load_unreal_offsets_from_file stages from logical keys (PROG:899-905); setup_lua_scan_overrides replaces the working dir with logical 'ue4ss' (Signatures.cpp:174-176); the VTableLayout.ini block is #ifndef __PROSPERO__ (PROG:1020-1220). All scan/config input on the init thread comes from context.module_source views + mod_source logical keys.

game_executable_path (and its derivations) has exactly these behavioral consumers, none on the engine-ready path: ValidateNativeProgramContext requires it to be an absolute normalized path WITH a filename that names an EXISTING REGULAR FILE and file_size succeeds (NPC:85-100); constructor diagnostic line re-runs std::filesystem::file_size (PROG:427); Lua helpers IterateGameDirectories/CreateLogicModsDirectory/LogicMods-reconstruction read get_game_executable_directory at mod-runtime (LuaMod.cpp:2939/3134/3274); SDKGenerator reads get_game_executable_path (UEHeaderGenerator.cpp:4172). If game_executable_path became an explicit configured root: setup_unreal/ScanGame/properties behavior is UNCHANGED, but a directory-style root is REJECTED by validation ('Native module and executable paths must name existing regular files'), and the Lua directory-derivation helpers silently change meaning (they assume <root>/Binaries/Win64 shape).

The only hard time bound on the init thread is StartupWait: Deadline = steady_clock::now() + 5 minutes (PROG:954-955, SWC:102 DefaultStartupWaitTimeout), checked cooperatively between engine calls (UI:67-98), throwing exact strings 'Unreal initialization cancelled' (SWC:20) and 'Unreal initialization startup deadline exceeded' (SWC:26); plus per-scan give-up settings_manager.General.SecondsToScanBeforeGivingUp (default coerced 30->120, SET:136-144) producing 'PS scan timed out' (UI:630). init() converts every exception to a stored error (PROG:691-714), Backend::initialize rethrows it (BACKEND:67-70), RuntimeOwner marks Failed and acks failed(1,<msg>) (OWNER:111-118). StartupCancelled with no stop request surfaces as failed(1,'Native runtime init returned without a stop request') (OWNER:102-109).

CORRECTION to worker-lua-bootstrap-audit C1: in the composition-5 linked source, main.lua does NOT run on the loader thread and NOT before the init thread. start_native_mods (PROG:580-583) calls setup_mods (creates LuaMod objects/VMs only, PROG:1742-1751), install_cpp_mods (CppMod-only, PROG:1836-1839), and start_cpp_mods -> start_mods<CppMod>, whose native branch starts Lua mods only under 'if constexpr (std::is_same_v<ModType, LuaMod>)' (PROG:1946-1956) and otherwise returns immediately. The only reachable start_lua_mods() sites are on_program_start (PROG:1488, update thread) and reinstall_mods (PROG:2295). Proof of linkage: composition-4 run-3 receipt program.source_sha256 dfdd5014... equals the current port file. Consequence: true order is engine-ready -> mods-started (both at PROG:660 via BACKEND:41-45) -> event loop jthread (PROG:673) -> update/on_program_start (PROG:1514) -> start_lua_mods -> LuaMod::start_mod main.lua exec (LuaMod.cpp:6440/6459-6463).

Reconciled ordering makes the Item Spawner OPTIONS (F7) chain safe: GUObjectArray is bound on the init thread BEFORE engine-ready (ScanGame second pass UObjectArray::SetupGUObjectArrayAddress, UI:895), together with the >=10000-object wait (UI:1062), KismetStringLibrary/Conv_NameToString/CDO location (UI:1076-1111), and IsInitialized()=true in PostInitialize (UI:454). main.lua's RegisterKeyBind(Key.F7) therefore registers against a fully bound object array; the load-time 'silent nil FindFirstOf' hazard in audit C5 does not apply on this path (no script runs before engine-ready). Remaining gap: no status line or default-verbosity log proves main.lua actually executed; a main.lua load failure logs 'Exception during mod startup: <what>' (LuaMod.cpp:6478-6480) and leaves runtime-status.txt ending at mods-started with F7 never registered.
